title: BREAKING: Laredo Police Arrest Juan Elizondo on Criminal Mischief Charge
excerpt: BREAKING: Laredo police arrested Juan Elizondo early Tuesday on a criminal mischief charge (property damage of $100 to under $750, a Class B misdemeanor). Bond was set at $1,000. An arrest is an allegation; the accused is presumed innocent.
content:
BREAKING — Laredo police arrested Juan Elizondo early Tuesday, October 20, 2026, on a criminal mischief charge, according to Webb County booking records.

Elizondo was arrested at 5:29 a.m. and booked into the Webb County Jail on one count of criminal mischief — damage or destruction of property valued at $100 or more but less than $750 — a Class B misdemeanor under Texas law. Bond was set at $1,000, cash or bail surety. Court records also list him under the name Juan Gabriel Elizondo, and he was taken before a magistrate at 10:25 a.m. on Tuesday.

Criminal mischief covers intentionally or knowingly damaging another person's property, and the class of the charge rises with the dollar value of the loss. A Class B misdemeanor in Texas is punishable by up to 180 days in jail and a fine of up to $2,000. The records reviewed by Webb Watch 956 do not describe what property was allegedly damaged or where the alleged offense happened.

Webb Watch 956 will follow this case as it moves through the Webb County courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Juan Elizondo is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal.
